newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ghana share index rises on Ashanti, Mobil gains.
newsitem.headline: Ghana share index rises on Ashanti, Mobil gains.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange index rose on Wednesday, led by gains in mining company Ashanti Goldfields and oil marketer Mobil Oil Ghana, the market report said.
The all-share index closed at 375.68 from 372.89 on Monday.
The rise was mainly due to increases in the prices of Ashanti Goldfields (+60 cedis to 21,610 cedis) and Mobil Oil Ghana (+100 cedis to 6,200 cedis).
Another large gainer was Social Security Bank (+15 cedis to 1,300 cedis).
Bids outpaced offers at 873,471 against 768,790. In total, 181,590 shares were traded compared to 32,990 shares on Monday.
